title: Async Execution and Local Model Integration
hypothesis: Executor-based async invocation prevents event-loop blocking and improves timeout accuracy vs synchronous calls
methodology: Code analysis and commit history comparison of sync vs async UI-TARS invocation

sync_baseline.problem: CPU inference per step takes 30-90s on local hardware; synchronous call blocked the asyncio event loop entirely; asyncio.wait_for() timeouts could not fire because the event loop was occupied with the blocking llama.cpp HTTP request
observed_failures: Tasks appeared to run indefinitely past timeout
Event loop blocked 30-90s per UI-TARS step

async_fix.description: Wrapped _uitars_decide in asyncio.get_running_loop().run_in_executor(None, ...) to execute in thread pool
async_fix.benefit: Thread pool execution frees the asyncio event loop; wait_for timeouts can fire; other coroutines (screen polling, HITL) run correctly during inference

sync_mode.description: Blocking HTTP call to local llama-server occupies event loop for entire inference duration

async_executor_mode.description: Inference runs in thread pool worker; event loop stays free; timeouts fire with <1ms overhead

code_pattern.before: _action = self._uitars_decide(shot_bytes, ax_context, history, stuck_count, task, context, plan)
code_pattern.after:
_loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
action = await _loop.run_in_executor(
    None,
    lambda: self._uitars_decide(
        shot_bytes, ax_context, history, stuck_count,
        task, context, plan or [],
        first_person_frame if iteration == 0 else None,
    ),
)

related_fix.gemini_async: commit 71e0adf — _gemini_generate also wrapped in run_in_executor for same reason (Gemini HTTP calls block event loop during retry sleeps)

conclusion: Hypothesis confirmed. Executor wrapping is the correct pattern for any synchronous IO-bound call inside an asyncio coroutine. Both UI-TARS and Gemini API calls are now executor-wrapped, making task timeouts reliable.
result: CONFIRMED — async executor mode required for correct timeout behavior
